# AbstractRuntime

> Durable workflow runtime (interrupt → checkpoint → resume) with an append-only execution ledger.

- Python: 3.10+ (see `pyproject.toml`)
- Version: 0.15.3
- Ecosystem: [AbstractFramework](https://github.com/lpalbou/AbstractFramework) umbrella, integrates with [AbstractCore](https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractcore)
- Hard invariant: `RunState.vars` must be JSON-serializable (`src/abstractruntime/core/models.py`)
- Current AbstractCore baseline: base `abstractruntime` requires AbstractCore 2.30.0 or newer with its light install (remote providers, tools and the MCP worker, media routing); `abstractruntime[apple]` and `abstractruntime[gpu]` require AbstractCore's `apple` and `gpu` settings (`pyproject.toml`)
- Install profiles: base `abstractruntime` is remote-light with MCP, generated media routing, and Runtime-owned permissive PDF read/write nodes; `abstractruntime[apple]` and `abstractruntime[gpu]` add local inferencer stacks.
- Config boundary: Runtime does not read `ABSTRACTGATEWAY_*`; Gateway-owned config should be translated into explicit Runtime inputs or Runtime-owned env names. Hosts can attach `resolve_provider_endpoint_profile(provider_id)` to the LLM client; Runtime treats it as an optional resolver hook, injects transient provider/base URL/key params for the call, and redacts secret-like params from persisted observability.

## Key code (source of truth)

- [Public exports](src/abstractruntime/__init__.py): supported external API surface
- [Runtime loop](src/abstractruntime/core/runtime.py): `start`/`tick`/`resume` semantics and built-in effect handlers
- [Core models](src/abstractruntime/core/models.py): `RunState`, `WaitState`, `StepPlan`, `Effect`, `StepRecord`
- [Scheduler wrapper](src/abstractruntime/scheduler/convenience.py): `create_scheduled_runtime()` / `ScheduledRuntime`
- [Storage interfaces](src/abstractruntime/storage/base.py): `RunStore`, `LedgerStore`, `QueryableRunStore`, `MailboxQueryableRunStore`
- [Triggers](src/abstractruntime/triggers/): sources, registry, connections, CloudEvents envelope, feed and webhook sources

## Integrations

- [Cancellation, pause and tool ceiling](docs/api.md#runtime-start--tick--resume): `Runtime.cancel_run(...)` stops the in-flight effect (recorded `cancelled`, never retried), a model unload cancels the calls using it first, `tick(..., step_gate=...)` pauses at step boundaries, and an explicit `allowed_tools` list is a run-tree ceiling approval policy cannot widen.
- [Live token streaming](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#live-token-streaming): `Runtime.set_live_delta_sink(sink)` plus run input `_runtime.stream: true` delivers `llm.delta` / `llm.delta_end` events (content and reasoning channels, `parent_run_id`) while an answer is generated; nothing reaches the ledger, children inherit the switch, and every call that cannot stream with a complete record says why (`reason: unavailable` + `detail`).
- [Unloading and switching models](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#unloading-and-switching-models): a default switch unloads the previous in-process model (MLX, HuggingFace, embeddings) unless another owner in the process claims it (pool, override, lock, building, default); a model still generating is unloaded when its call ends; diagnostics `pending_ejects` / `last_switch_ejects`; any listed row unloads by `runtime_id` (`local:<task>:<provider>:<model>`, including `local:embedding:<provider>:<model>`); `ttl_s` / `keep_alive` on in-process or already-loaded models are reported under `unsupported_options`.
- [Workspace-scoped tools](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#workspace-scoped-tools): `workspace_root`, `workspace_access_mode`, `workspace_allowed_paths`, `workspace_ignored_paths`, and the host-only `workspace_builtin_deny_prefixes` / `workspace_builtin_allow` (enforced, never shown to the model) scope file and shell tools; the most specific row wins (longest real-path prefix, a refusal wins a tie, built-ins absolute); `execute_command`/`shell_exec`/`local_helper_start`/`execute_python` get the same set stamped as the hidden `_sandbox` arg and run inside AbstractCore's OS sandbox (refused when the host has none); child runs inherit them.
- [Execution controls](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#execution-controls-and-local-concurrency): inherited run/node MTP controls, scoped Core defaults, actual-host execution discovery, instance-aware scheduling, per-response outcomes and cache-group batching limits.

- [AbstractCore integration](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md): `LLM_CALL` / `TOOL_CALLS` / `MODEL_RESIDENCY`, local/remote/hybrid, prompt-cache and residency host controls, host memory snapshots and per-session prompt-cache listing/clearing, host-wide provider-server rows in residency listings, model-residency locks (residency-required: locking a non-resident pair refuses with `model_not_resident`; unlock never requires residency) with `force`-gated unload and context-estimate relays, modality/host-identity fields and truthful `pinned`-aliases-`locked` lock state on local residency rows, local-only prompt-cache export/import admin, durable bloc/KV prompt-cache controls, discovery snapshot queries including `list_provider_models(..., capability_route=...)` and `list_vision_adapters(...)`, durable run-scoped image/edit-image/upscale-image/text-to-video/image-to-video/voice/streamed-voice/music/STT execution, batch `count`/`n`, `seeds`, ordered `lora_adapters`, video `flow_shift`, media inputs, generated media outputs, progress ledger events, provider-key headers, host endpoint-profile resolver hooks, and tool approval waits
- [AbstractMemory integration](docs/integrations/abstractmemory.md): `MemoryFacade` is the complete host surface for AbstractMemory 0.4.0 (ADR 0011): `open_mind`, `stamp` / `stamp_current_step`, `reconstruct_source` (`ok`, `partial`, `mismatch`, `source_gone`, `unsupported`), `history`, `sources_of`, `apply_revision`; `LedgerStore.get_record(run_id, seq)`; the step context; the `MEMORY_REVISE` effect and `memory_revise` node
- VisualFlow LLM Call and Agent nodes forward Core generation controls such as `thinking`; Provider Models nodes can apply Core `capability_route` filters during runtime discovery.
- Prompt-cache tracks: use `LLM_CALL.params.prompt_cache_key`, `run.vars["_runtime"]["prompt_cache"]`, or `ABSTRACTRUNTIME_PROMPT_CACHE` for best-effort text/chat session reuse; use `LLM_CALL.params.prompt_cache_binding` for durable exact bloc-backed reuse; and use `get_abstractcore_host_facade(runtime).list_prompt_cache_exports(...)`, `prompt_cache_export(...)`, and `prompt_cache_import(...)` only for host-local operator/admin export-import workflows around live local provider caches. Runtime does not auto-derive prompt-cache keys for image/video/voice/music/STT output selectors. Derived session keys are stamped with session attribution after each generate so hosts can use `list_session_prompt_caches(...)` / `clear_session_prompt_caches(...)` per session; caller-owned keys are never stamped, and completing a run does not clear session caches. Local Runtime stores one content-addressed bloc per root plus provider/model-specific derived KV artifacts. Gateway prompt-cache env belongs in Gateway.
- Durable bloc lifecycle: Runtime exposes `list_blocs(...)`, `list_bloc_kv_artifacts(...)`, `delete_bloc_kv_artifact(...)`, `prune_bloc_kv_artifacts(...)`, and `delete_bloc(...)`, with `dry_run`, `clear_loaded`, and `force` safety controls on the host facade.
- Runtime-owned Core surfaces: `get_abstractcore_discovery_facade(...)`, `get_abstractcore_host_facade(...)`, `get_abstractcore_voice_facade(...)` ([voice library](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#voice-library): languages, cloned voices, cloning, voice design, the capability catalog) and `get_abstractcore_run_facade(...)`
- Host-local operator wrappers: the host facade exposes single-user email helpers (`list_email_accounts`, `list_emails`, `read_email`, `send_email`), `abstractruntime.integrations.abstractcore.email_facade` re-exports AbstractCore's mail library for multi-user hosts, and `abstractruntime.integrations.abstractcore.telegram_facade` exposes Telegram bootstrap/global-client/send wrappers without requiring hosts to import AbstractCore directly.
- Durable outbound comms: when an email or Telegram send belongs to a run, use `get_abstractcore_run_facade(...).send_email(...)` or `send_telegram_message(...)` so Runtime records the request and outcome in a child run; replay should show the recorded result, not resend the message. If the child run waits for approval or passthrough execution, resume it through `resume_tool_calls(...)`.
- [Artifacts](docs/artifacts.md): Runtime artifact identity, JSON-safe refs, canonical descriptors, generated-media provenance, tool-output offload thresholds, catalog search/stats, access counters, and Gateway/Observer retrieval boundaries.
- [Conversation search](docs/api.md#conversation-search): `ConversationSearch(db_path, run_store=, ledger_store=, artifact_store=)` keeps one SQLite FTS5 trigram index per runtime plane over each turn's question, answer and media (generated artifacts by their prompt, attachments by their file name), lowercased and without accents; `sync(budget_s=)` indexes what changed within a time budget and reports what is left (`SyncReport`), `search(query, limit=, sessions=, exclude=, session_kinds=)` returns one `SearchHit` per session (its best turn, a snippet, highlight positions, `matched_in` question / answer / artifact, the matching `artifact`), exact matches first then a fuzzy pass that forgives a typo.
- [Sessions and history](docs/api.md#sessions-and-history): `session_chat_messages(...)` replays a session's completed turns under one window, the most recent `HISTORY_REPLAY_MAX_TOKENS` (50,000) estimated tokens of whole messages, and returns a `ReplayedHistory` whose `.report` records replayed and dropped messages and tokens; `fold_history_window(...)` applies the same window to any turns, `window_transcript(...)` to a transcript you already hold, and `announce_dropped(...)` writes the window's `#TRUNCATION` notice.
- [Artifacts API](docs/api.md#artifacts-store-by-reference): `ArtifactStore`, `ArtifactDescriptor`, `ArtifactAccessStats`, `search()`, `count()`, `facet_counts()`, and `stats()` for Runtime-owned catalog queries.
- VisualFlow document/file nodes: `read_file`/`write_file` use workspace-scoped paths (`rel/path` or `mount_alias/rel/path` in Gateway-hosted runs), `read_pdf` extracts text/metadata with `pypdf`, `write_pdf` renders text or Markdown-style content to real PDF bytes with `reportlab`, `list_folder_files` enumerates workspace folders, `import_workspace_file` snapshots a server file into an artifact, `read_artifact` projects saved file content, and `export_artifact` writes a durable artifact back to a workspace path. Local Runtime-only runs without workspace scope still fall back to the process working directory for relative file-node paths.
- Remote multimodal guardrail: remote/hybrid media generation uses AbstractCore Server endpoints, does not inherit the chat model for media endpoints, routes image edits through Core `/images/edits`, routes video generation through Core `/videos/*`, rejects unsupported input media and non-file STT inputs instead of ignoring them, and redacts data URLs from persisted provider-request metadata
- [MCP worker](docs/mcp-worker.md): `abstractruntime-mcp-worker` CLI (stdio/HTTP)
- [Comms toolset](docs/tools-comms.md): email enabled by the host (`email_enabled=True`, no env flag); WhatsApp/Telegram env gating
- [Email](docs/email.md): one user, one runtime, one mailbox: `_runtime.email_account` binding resolved at call time through `Runtime.set_email_context_resolver` (credentials never in vars, ledger or results), `send_email_recipient@v2` (unattended only to self or to the definition's `policy.email_allowed_recipients`), the resolver's `use` (`agent_tool` / `action`) so a host's agent-tools switch gates agent tools only, large structured tool outputs offloaded to attachments, durable event inbox (`JsonFileEventInbox`, retention 90 days / 10,000 events via `prune_email_inbox`) filled by `EmailInboxFeeder.poll` (read-only, per-message cursor, UIDVALIDITY resync, typed failures with backoff), the `email.received@1` trigger on the primary or another mailbox of the user (`config.account`; typed filters, batches every `every`, each message once, untrusted input: messages and framed prompt stored as artifacts (refs only in the controller's records), frame markers with a per-occurrence random boundary, and "allow all tools" granting by kind only (no network egress beyond configured services, no execution, no messaging, no writes outside the workspace (the memory-writing tools included), no delegation; anything else only when named in `policy.untrusted_input_tools`, sending tools never; under "ask" nothing runs unasked but the named tools, and the executor's static defaults never decide for an untrusted run or its children)) and the send-email action (fixed-placeholder templates)
- [Automations](docs/automations.md): event triggers `feed.item@1` (RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF) and Atom, host-run `poll_feed_connections`) and `webhook.received@1` (Standard Webhooks, `verify_standard_webhook`, `append_webhook_event`) on per-user trigger connections (`TriggerConnectionStore`, sealed secrets, `test_fire`, stream `trigger:<id>`); every occurrence receives `input_data.event` (CloudEvents 1.0) and `_meta.origin`; wakes: `SCHEDULE_RUN` / `Runtime.set_schedule_run_handler` / `create_scheduled_run` (one-shot, same session, at most the caller's tools, note reminders raise attention); configurable growing-context budgets and result email; an automation is a durable controller run that starts its target as deterministic child runs (occurrences) on `schedule@1` (fixed UTC intervals, coalesced missed ticks), `schedule@2` (the same plus daily/weekly/monthly wall-time rules in an IANA time zone, DST-correct) or `manual@1`; `create_automation`, `apply_automation_command` (pause, resume, run_now, revise, stop_current, archive, unarchive — back paused with its history, nothing deleted; idempotent per `command_id`), independent or growing context, `start_discussion` (fork at any occurrence N, seeded with the timeline 1..N, own writable workspace, the automation's workspace mounted read-only via `_runtime.workspace_read_only_paths`: file writes refused inside, reads and commands allowed), `policy.tool_approval` (`auto` or `ask`), `policy.email_allowed_recipients`, `notify.channels`, the `email.received@1` trigger, typed `pending_waits`, `notify` attention items and retries; storage guarantees: `create_if_absent`, `run_mutation_lock`, turn roots and `session_kind` in the run index, one writer process per store, `Runtime.start` refusing session starts it cannot attribute
- [Mail verbs for flows](docs/email.md#mail-verbs-for-flows): `mail_search`, `mail_get`, `mail_mark`, `mail_label`, `mail_move`, `mail_delete`, `mail_send`, `mail_reply`, `mail_forward`, `mail_attachment` on the run's mailbox; changes and sends need a Read and write mailbox (AbstractCore's `EmailAccount.access`), else `email_mailbox_read_only`; sends also need an outgoing server, else `email_mailbox_cannot_send` (both refused before connecting)
- [Publish to channel](docs/automations.md#publish-to-channel): `PUBLISH_EVENT` `{channel, type?, title, body?, subject?, data?, alert?, recipient?, channels?}` handed to `Runtime.set_publish_event_handler(handler)`; `recipient` defaults to `"me"`, `channels` (from `tray`, `watch`, `phone`, `email`, `console`; absent = all) needs `alert: true`; the visual envelope is stripped (`strip_visual_envelope`) and a node's `type` pin travels as `event_type`
- [Tool approval](docs/tool-approval.md): tool risk tiers, the run-policy rank ceiling, per-call refiners, and the session tool policy (a conversation's standing approve/deny, applied before any approval wait)
- [Entity runtime](docs/entity-runtime.md): per-entity runtimes, homes, the one-writer lease, act-only diary privacy, and durable visit waits
- [Models, engines and host jobs](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#models-engines-and-host-jobs-config-facade): `config_facade` passthroughs for hosts; `host_job_cancel(job_id, *, by="api", user=None)` records who cancelled a job

## Durability & observability

- [Evidence capture](docs/evidence.md): artifact-backed evidence for boundary tools
- [Replay view](docs/replay.md): one reconstruction of a run tree from its ledger (status, the interaction to answer, messages, one activity per execution, artifacts, usage, the workflow it executes), deltas, the durable cursor (`seq`, `list_after`), conformance cases
- [Snapshots](docs/snapshots.md): named bookmarks of run state
- [Provenance](docs/provenance.md): tamper-evident hash-chained ledger
- [Large run folders](docs/architecture.md#reading-a-large-run-folder-without-scanning-it): `JsonFileRunStore` active index and trusted run index (`trust_index=True` default, `False` = verify with `run_index_stats()["shadow_mismatches"]`, `reconcile_run_index()`), the creation journal's `=<run_id>` line, `change_token()` / `changed_run_ids()` on the run store and `ObservableLedgerStore`, event-wait and mailbox indexes refreshed from another process's saves (at least every 2 s), the active-consumers index (`connections_usage`, `invalidate_active_consumers`, `automation_generation`), `ArtifactStore.list_session_candidates`
- Automation listings that do not grow with history: `pending_waits` from the WAITING run-index rows, `pending_waits_by_automation`, `latest_occurrence(runtime, id)` read from the ledger's end, `list_automations(index_rows=)` ([automations.md](docs/automations.md#reading-automations))
- `set_default_model_warmup(False)` (`abstractruntime.integrations.abstractcore.llm_client`): a process that never generates builds the default model client at its first call instead of at construction ([integrations/abstractcore.md](docs/integrations/abstractcore.md#unloading-and-switching-models))

## Distribution

- [WorkflowBundles](docs/workflow-bundles.md): `.flow` bundle format, VisualFlow compilation, concrete multi-entry fan-in metadata, and shared/framework registry directory resolution
- VisualFlow media nodes: `generate_image`, `edit_image`/`image_to_image`, `generate_video`/`text_to_video`, `image_to_video`, `generate_voice`, `generate_music`, and `transcribe_audio` compile to `LLM_CALL` with an `output` selector; `listen_voice` compiles to `WAIT_EVENT` (no client-side lowering required)
- [VisualFlow compiler](docs/architecture.md): lowers multi-entry `entryRoutes` / `inputRouteOverrides` into internal `join_exec` / `path_mux` nodes
